merges.notes: Most non-version conflicts came from upstream's one-time i18n sweep (#37893), which rewrote copy on lines next to fork edits. Upstream's no-untranslated-copy lint then failed the fork's plugin code with 123 errors, fixed in c409166607. ced1d3d425 (release checksum guard) is unrelated to the merge. All resolutions keep both sides' intent. The i18n follow-up missed two template-literal strings the lint rule does not catch: apps/mobile/src/features/settings/SettingsRouteScreen.tsx (`${pluginDecisions} new`) and apps/web/src/components/plugins/SidebarPluginsNotice.tsx (New plugin / N new plugins labels), fixed in a later commit on the same branch.
followUps: version-line repeats every merge (4 package.json files, also in v0.1.10) but cannot move: apps/server reads its package.json version at runtime (cli/*, serverVersion drives ServerUpdateAction's release-track check). Instead, have the merge step resolve it mechanically: a fork-only merge driver script (scripts/) registered per clone in .git/info/attributes for **/package.json that runs git merge-file and then restores the fork's version line. Keep it out of the committed .gitattributes, which is upstream's file.

apps/web/src/components/settings/settingsSearch.ts is a repeat (v0.1.10, top hotFile, 17 fork lines). Move the two plugin SETTINGS_SEARCH_ITEMS entries into an as-const array in a fork-only apps/web/src/components/plugins/pluginSettingsSearch.ts (type-only import of SettingsSearchItem, no cycle) and spread it as the last element of SETTINGS_SEARCH_ITEMS in one line. The four Record<SettingsPath, ...>/union/nav-group entries must stay inline because the Records are exhaustive over SettingsPath, but put each at the end of its structure rather than alphabetically among upstream's lines, where they collided this time.

apps/mobile/src/features/settings/SettingsRouteScreen.tsx is a repeat (v0.1.10). Move the plugin row (pluginDecisionCountAtom read plus the page("SettingsPlugins", ...) entry) into a usePluginsSettingsRow(selectedTargets) hook in features/plugins; upstream's file then keeps one import, one hook call and one array entry instead of nine lines. The row's `${n} new` value gets translated in the move.

apps/web/src/components/ChatMarkdown.tsx is not a repeat yet but sits high in hotFiles with 51 fork lines in upstream's most-churned rendering file. Candidate: wrap MarkdownAnchor in a fork-only withPluginLinks() (takeover href/text, PluginLinkHover) so CHAT_MARKDOWN_COMPONENTS.a changes in one line, and route the file-link chip wrap through one call. Feasibility depends on exporting ChatMarkdownRendererContext and computing canUseShellActions outside useChatMarkdownState; revisit if it conflicts again.

merges.notes: b8c03dfa7c moves the fork's PanelPlugins layer from the layerRuntimeCoreDependenciesBase pipe into the end of its Layer.mergeAll list, because upstream added a pipe step and the fork's made 21, past pipe's limit. The layer still gets its requirements from the later provideMerge steps and still exposes PanelPlugins, PluginDiscovery and PluginGateway; no mergeAll sibling consumes them, so the move changes nothing. The plugin gateway path, which carries the panel's token, is now traced with the token recorded as REDACTED rather than untraced, and its handler keeps withLoggerDisabled. Reviewed by a second agent: all resolutions keep both sides' intent; server, web and mobile typecheck, i18n:check, and the PluginGatewayHttp, PanelPlugins, http, ws and AppBar.android tests pass.

The 10 apps/web i18n catalogs top hotFiles (80 fork lines each) and conflicted for the first time; the 10 mobile catalogs (90 fork lines) are next. They are generated, so resolve them mechanically: a fork-only merge driver for apps/*/src/i18n/translations/*.json, registered per clone in .git/info/attributes like the version-line driver, takes the key union of both sides (upstream's value wins on a clash), and the merge step then runs i18n:generate.
